title: Israel's History of Rebellion and Grace
description: God explains Israel's repeated rebellion against him—from Egypt, through the wilderness, and into the promised land—but emphasizes that he spared the people for the sake of his name. The prophecy ends with a promise of a future gathering from the nations and cleansing, where the people will serve God on his holy mountain [ref:Esek 20:1-44|Ezekiel 20:1-44].
